verdict.rationale: Honeycomb, an observability SaaS rather than an agent, documents an official MCP server with a configuration guide for connecting any MCP-capable agent. It also publishes a tools reference covering discovery, query, trace, Board, Trigger, SLO and Canvas tools, plus use-case guidance. Independent community reports show engineers using Honeycomb's MCP server in LLM-agent incident workflows, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs exist.
